children: Cambium Networks sold its defense business and certain fixed broadband product lines to Airspan for $27.5 million in cash, completed at signing, with up to $7.5 million of additional consideration based on net collections of transferred receivables, less costs. The deal includes a $2.5 million holdback and a concurrent bill of sale for U.S.-related assets. To support a smooth transition, the parties also executed transitional services, IP licensing (including cnMaestro), distribution, and facility occupancy agreements. The agreements collectively transfer operations while maintaining customer and channel continuity.
